sessions.title: Project switcher in the title bar

waiting_for.text: Keep Workspaces in the menu until every project has moved?

plan.summary: The title bar's project button opens a switcher that lists each project with its repositories under it. Fleet serves the list, and the switcher only draws it.

groups.title: Propose
groups.gives: A plan you approve before anything is built

tasks.text: Read the title bar and the projects Fleet serves
Record the plan with the two sketches

groups.title: Switcher rows
groups.gives: Each project a row, its repositories under it, the one you are in marked

tasks.text: Draw a row for each project with its repositories under it
Mark the project the window is on, and move with the arrows

groups.title: Fleet serves projects
groups.gives: One list of projects that every screen reads

tasks.text: Serve each project with its repositories in one view

pieces.text: Read the Projects Document, the code it touches and every doc it cites
Record the plan with what exists, what is new and what is open
Mock Electron's repository picker and System > Workspaces reading projects from a mock Fleet
Show the walk and wait for your approval
Rename the multi-repository Workspace to Project in core-model and config; a member is a repository with an optional folder
Allow a project with no members yet, so a new one can be made before it holds anything
Read project files from Kit's projects folder and a repository's .armada/projects, as Workspace files are read
Keep each project at one of the four places, This Mac by default, reusing run memory's places
At Fleet start, move Workspace files to projects and make each task list a project whose members are its tasks' repositories
Keep lifecycles, rules and autonomy pieces scoped to a project working, by its id
Grow list_projects: each project with members, place, file and values; drop /workspaces/all
Add create_project and edit_project; delete_project also removes the project's file
Add project to StartSession, keep it on the Job's record and serve it on the Job
Mirror the wire in packages/protocol and point Electron's Workspace reader at list_projects, the smallest change
Rewrite docs/concepts/project.md and the projects protocol page, and fix scope.md's 'None of the first row'
One resolver for behaviour keys: default, Machine, Kit, repository, Project, Job, each value with the layer it came from
Project values for pull request mode, auto merge, autonomy defaults, review model, Job layout, theme and density
A Job freezes its project's resolved values at start and runs on them
A project's tracker replaces its members' trackers for Jobs in it and for the project's issues
Serve each value with its layer for Settings, document the chain and close kit-machine-manifest-resolution-chain
get_review_lists takes a project and returns only its members' pull requests
An Operator rule's scope becomes a repository or a project; repository beats project beats everywhere
OperatorLearned carries the scope on the wire and in the TypeScript mirror, and Electron reads it
Move existing Always here rules across as repository-scoped
Show each new test failing without its change, then passing, through armada check test
Run vitest on touched files and --project 'desktop*', then pnpm format:check
Open each pull request, fix what is red, and merge on green with --merge --auto
